_comment: MarketBliss hooks. Blends pair-programmer governance hooks with RLM observability pattern. All bash entries use POSIX; powershell entries are Windows-native. Hooks are best-effort; if scripts are missing they no-op (intentional — scripts under .claude/hooks/ are v2).

SessionStart.bash: echo '[marketbliss] session-start: MarketBliss operational marketing org loaded' >> progress/events.jsonl 2>/dev/null || true
SessionStart.powershell: if (Test-Path progress) { Add-Content -Path progress/events.jsonl -Value '[marketbliss] session-start: MarketBliss operational marketing org loaded' }

SessionStart.bash: test -f progress/checkpoint.json && echo '[marketbliss] checkpoint loaded' >> progress/events.jsonl || true
SessionStart.powershell: if (Test-Path progress/checkpoint.json) { Add-Content -Path progress/events.jsonl -Value '[marketbliss] checkpoint loaded' }

PreToolUse._comment: Pre-tool safety placeholder — block destructive operations once .claude/hooks/pre-tool-safety is implemented.
Pre-edit safety placeholder — protect sealed campaign briefs once .claude/hooks/pre-tool-safety-edit is implemented.
Route every evolution proposal through eights.governance.policy.evaluate before commit.

PostToolUse._comment: Post-write structural validation placeholder — validate CreativeBrief / MarketBrief / DecisionRecord shape once .claude/hooks/post-write-validate is implemented.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Team-suggester placeholder — surface relevant /pp:team or /campaign-* command on prompt submit.
